result.plainSummary: The Specs list shows progress and fixups, and its Active view matches the count on Overview.
result.summary: Independent bounded review of discoverability acceptance 5–7. Seven new navigation adversarial tests pass; all 44 UI adversarial tests pass. Actual server-page invocation loads only the selected 20 rows and isolates failed or mismatched observations. Tests cover every workstream status, shared active count and URL, deterministic bounded pagination, empty and invalid views, exact-owner non-abandoned typed fixups rather than title keywords, unknown historical readiness, native filter and paging links, explicit refresh, compact and summary badges, and requested correction with discovery context before evidence. Inspected all eight final screenshots: desktop and mobile active lists match Overview at two active specs, progress remains consistent with detail, owning-spec fixup links and correction are visible, and historical readiness remains distinct. Final visual evidence gate passes. Reviewed the prior turn amendment: only intent.changeType changed from feature to fix, without rewriting its facts. Reviewed three attributed audit criteria and independently validated 57 criteria across eight workstreams. No actionable findings remain.
